messages:
maya: Quick follow-up from last night's incident — want to lock owners/timelines for the action items we agreed in the postmortem. Main items: SLO tweak proposal, dashboard cutover + alert thresholds, and runbook for recurring latency spikes on inference-host pool. Error budget burned ~32% last week during the burst.

sam: I can own the SLO proposal. Thinking we should try a temporary 2-week relaxation on the 99th p99 from 150ms -> 220ms while we patch the GC/kernel issue, then re-evaluate with traffic-weighted evals. Will write up rationale & rollback plan.

lee: I'll take dashboard cutover and alerts. ETA Wed EOD to flip the dashboard to the new query and update the alert to use a 5m aggregated window + mute policy during batch jobs. I'll open the PR once I finish the panel remap.

irene: I'll own the runbook + recurring incident tracking. We need a recurring ticket for monthly review and add a segment in the oncall handoff notes. Also will add the kernel tuning steps (disable swap, tune vm.min_free_kbytes) we used during remediation.

tim: Product okay with a short SLO widening if we get a clear comms plan and a plan that ties the widened SLO to deployment windows. Can we include a short consumer-facing note if the change goes into effect?

maya: Good. Draft owners/tl;dr here — please confirm: 
- SLO proposal: sam — due 2026-03-30
- Dashboard + alerts: lee — due 2026-03-27
- Runbook + recurring review: irene — due 2026-03-28
- Notify CS/product comms: tim to confirm messaging by 2026-03-26

sam: Confirmed. I'll attach the SLO diff and perf validation plan to the postmortem doc. Draft path: https://redwood.internal/docs/postmortems/1765-slo-draft (WIP).

lee: putting the alert config here so ops can review quickly:

```yaml
alert: InferenceHostHighP99
expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(inference_latency_seconds_bucket[5m]))) > 0.22
for: 10m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  runbook: /runbooks/inference_high_p99
```

lee: I'll add a mute rule during nightly batch jobs and a temporary auto-silence for the next 2 weeks after we flip.

irene: Noted on the kernel params. I'll include exact sysctl commands in the runbook and the rollout checklist. Rough commands: `sysctl -w vm.swappiness=10; sysctl -w vm.min_free_kbytes=67584` — will verify on staging before prod.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout for inference-host pool patch completed at 2026-03-24T22:14:03Z — 3/3 canaries passed.

maya: Nice, thanks @deploy-bot :white_check_mark:

sam: One ask — can we add a short eval harness to measure p99 under mixed small/long sequences? I'll add a Jenkins job and a perf dashboard panel.

lee: Ack. If you add the Jenkins job, ping me and I'll wire the panel to the new metric series.

irene: I'll schedule the recurring incident review in the oncall calendar. Proposed cadence: 1st Monday of every month for 30m with the SRE leads + product representative.

tim: Sounds good. I'll draft the customer note template for CS and let maya review.

maya: Final checklist from this thread:
- sam: SLO proposal + perf validation (due 3/30)
- lee: dashboard + alert PR + mute policy (due 3/27)
- irene: runbook + sysctl commands + monthly review invite (due 3/28)
- tim: CS messaging template (due 3/26)

maya: Please update the postmortem action tracker with the Jira IDs when you create the tickets. I'll do a follow-up review next Friday and close the loop.

sam: Added draft, jira INF-4821 for SLO proposal.

lee: Created dashboard PR #412 and jira INF-4822 for alerts.

irene: Runbook ticket INF-4823 created and recurring calendar invite sent.

maya: Thanks team — let's aim to not re-open the same postmortem next month. :pray:

lee: ack :thumbsup:

sam: ack

tim: ack

irene: ack

maya: Closing thread — will update the postmortem doc with these owners/links.
